Job Title: Senior Java Developer
Experience: 6-10 years
Location: India

Mandatory Skills:
- Java
- Docker
- Spring Boot
- Apache Kafka

Good to have:
- Kubernetes
- Microservices
- MySQL
- REST APIs

Responsibilities:
- Join a fast-growing fintech engineering team at a mid-stage startup building scalable payment and transaction processing systems.
- Design and implement backend services using Java and Spring Boot that meet high throughput and low latency requirements.
- Develop, containerize and deploy services with Docker; collaborate on CI/CD pipelines to ensure reliable delivery.
- Architect and implement event-driven workflows using Apache Kafka for real-time data streaming, messaging, and system integration.
- Work closely with product, QA and DevOps to define APIs, data models and integration patterns; contribute to API design and documentation for REST APIs.
- Mentor junior developers, conduct code reviews, and help establish best practices around microservices architecture and service observability.
- Troubleshoot production incidents, perform performance tuning, and participate in on-call rotations as needed.
- Advocate for and assist with adoption of orchestration and cloud-native practices; contribute to design and migration discussions around Kubernetes and scalable infrastructure.
